subject: MERGE statement
notes: Rule: 'During the execution of the output procedure, no statement may be executed manipulating the file referenced by or accessing the record area associated with file-name-2 or file-name-3.' (cite.py --check 14.9.24.4 -> OK §14.9.24.4 10)). This is a constraint on the PROGRAM with no exception condition and no prescribed consequence, so it asks nothing of the implementation beyond not depending on such access; the rule names no diagnostic and the range is dynamic, so a compile-time refusal would reject legal source whose violating path never executes. Code: EmitMerge completes every USING transfer (implicit OPEN/READ/CLOSE) and the k-way merge BEFORE entering the output procedure, so a violating statement meets a closed connector (deterministic, within 'undefined'); nothing in the implementation relies on file-name-2/-3 being untouched during the procedure. No finding. (The early CLOSE is GR7 c)'s timing question - part 1, not this rule.)
